scope.description: Whole Oracle Database application/driver breadth across the 24 public capability families in docs/design/oracle-coverage.md.
scope.denominator: Connection/session, dictionary, scalar types, table definitions, loading, selection, joins/set operations, aggregation/analytics, typed expressions, mutation, transactions, schema evolution, LOBs, JSON, PL/SQL routines, object/collection/XML types, vector, spatial/graph/text, AQ, notifications, performance/observability, Thin/Thick and authentication, administration, other Oracle products.

coverage.rationale: Useful partial coverage across relational tables, reports, transactions and bounded document storage: CLOB/BLOB and native JSON with typed scalar extraction now join the existing shared table contract. Existing-table mutation has snapshot, idempotency and precommit verification. Major Oracle families remain unimplemented; this is an editorial estimate, not an API ratio.

scope.description: Declared typed tables to inspect, load, relational report and atomic mutation workflows with independent verification.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Shared typed tables and named relations/conditions/steps express relational and bounded document intent without SQL, scripts, driver code or transaction replay logic. Users still choose schema, keys, joins, paths and business preconditions.

limitations: The whole application includes 24 retained capability families; none is claimed exhaustively covered. Native acceptance is bounded to the recorded Thin driver and Free server; registration freshness is reported independently.
Streaming and empty LOBs, NCLOB/BFILE, advanced SQL/JSON, schema evolution, PL/SQL, vector, spatial/graph/text, AQ and other specialist families remain unimplemented.
